# 035 -> 026: ADR-035 checks its own C4 clarification directly against ADR-026's own title
# ("checked against ADR-026 rather than assumed") -- removing the citation would remove the
# reader's ability to verify that check was real, not merely restate a technical fact. Whether
# that verification act itself needs a citation to stand, or can be restated without one, is a
# judgement call reported to the owner rather than decided unilaterally.
035	026
